provenance.note: No real microphone recordings of two physical objects have been made in this checkout. No metric below is invented or borrowed from the 4.x synthetic reference model.

gates.detail: Two genuinely different physical objects have not been enrolled with live microphone takes.
No false-match count can be reported without held-out unknown trials.
No 1 m, 2 m, room-noise or competing-appliance trials exist.
No replay trials exist. The prototype has no liveness detector.
No physical trial set exists from which to report latency or usable-frame ratio.

limitations: This is an experiment, not an authentication system, proof of ownership or tamper-proof usage meter.
A client can claim live microphone provenance; the local server validates structure and quality, not physical presence.
Playback, identical appliances, distance, orientation, room reverberation and competing noise can change similarity.
The existing 4.x field gates and PayPal Sandbox evidence are unchanged and remain the only validated product path.
No public claim, deployment, release or submission should be made from this NOT_RUN record.
